mapper.select: SELECT pypi.*, (select code from pro_yt_product where id =pypi.product_id ) as productCode, (select number from pur_yt_apply_purchase where id=pypi.apply_purchase_id) as applyNumber, (select b.code from sal_yt_order_sub a left join sal_yt_order b on a.order_id=b.id where a.id=pypi.order_sub_id) as orderCode, (select b.remark from sal_yt_order_sub a left join sal_yt_order b on a.order_id=b.id where a.id=pypi.order_sub_id) as orderNote, (select hand_product_level from pro_yt_product_specification where id = pypi.specification_id) as handProductLevel FROM pur_yt_purchase_item as pypi WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT SUM(supplier_price * number) AS total_amount FROM pur_yt_purchase_item WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT MIN(status) AS min_status FROM pur_yt_purchase_item WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and specification_id is not null AND is_deleted = 0

INSERT INTO pur_yt_purchase_item ( purchase_id, apply_purchase_id, product_id, specification_id, order_sub_id,order_sub_item_id,enter_number, supplier_price, remark, category_specification_item_id, category_specification_item_name, number, customer_id, customer_name, sales_employee_id, status, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted ) VALUES
( #{item.purchaseId}, #{item.applyPurchaseId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.specificationId}, #{item.orderSubId},#{item.orderSubItemId},#{item.enterNumber}, #{item.supplierPrice}, #{item.remark}, #{item.categorySpecificationItemId}, #{item.categorySpecificationItemName}, #{item.number}, #{item.customerId}, #{item.customerName}, #{item.salesEmployeeId}, #{item.status}, #{item.createUser}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateUser}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.isDeleted} )

select pypi.* FROM pur_yt_purchase_item AS pypi where order_sub_item_id =#{orderSubItemId} and is_deleted=0
select pypi.* FROM pur_yt_purchase_item AS pypi where pypi.confirm_item_id=#{confirmId} and pypi.is_deleted=0

select pypi.* FROM pur_yt_purchase_item AS pypi where pypi.purchase_id=#{purchaseId} and pypi.is_deleted=0 and pypi.status=#{status}
select pypi.* FROM pur_yt_purchase_item AS pypi where pypi.purchase_id=#{purchaseId} and pypi.is_deleted=0 and pypi.specification_id is not null and pypi.status=#{status}

-- SELECT -- CASE -- WHEN (SELECT sum(number) FROM pur_yt_purchase_item WHERE confirm_item_id = pypi.id AND is_deleted = 0) = pypi.number THEN '1' -- ELSE '0' -- END AS status, -- COUNT(*) AS count -- FROM pur_yt_purchase_item AS pypi -- WHERE pypi.purchase_id = {purchaseId} -- AND pypi.is_deleted = 0 -- AND pypi.specification_id IS NULL -- GROUP BY status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( -- 内层先计算每条记录的正确 status SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT sum(number) FROM pur_yt_purchase_item WHERE confirm_item_id = pypi.id AND is_deleted = 0) = pypi.number THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS status FROM pur_yt_purchase_item AS pypi WHERE pypi.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND pypi.is_deleted = 0 AND pypi.specification_id IS NULL ) AS temp GROUP BY status;
